title: Quiet Diplomacy
text:
Diplomacy rests on the patient management of divergent national interests. Envoys often pursue incremental concessions rather than sweeping settlements, because a premature breakthrough can provoke domestic backlash. Such negotiations are therefore frequently characterised by deliberate ambiguity in their final communiqués.

Critics argue that this preference for ambiguity can obscure genuine disagreements and allow commitments to lapse unnoticed. Proponents respond that vagueness preserves room for compromise, since a precisely worded agreement may be impossible to ratify. The durability of an accord, in their view, depends less on its clarity than on the continued willingness of both parties to honour it.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, why do envoys often pursue incremental concessions?
options: Because they never intend to reach any settlement
Because their governments forbid final agreements
Because a premature breakthrough can provoke domestic backlash
Because communiqués must be written in advance

questions.text: What do critics say the preference for ambiguity can do?
options: It guarantees that every commitment will be ratified
It can allow commitments to lapse unnoticed
It makes negotiations take less time
It removes all disagreement from talks

questions.text: What can be inferred about how proponents view vague agreements?
options: They see vagueness as a way to keep compromise possible
They believe vagueness is always harmful
They think clear wording always makes an accord more durable

questions.text: How would the author's overall attitude toward diplomatic ambiguity be best described?
options: Balanced, showing both its risks and its benefits

the quality of having more than one possible meaning

paragraph_translations: Diplomasi, farklı ulusal çıkarların sabırla yönetilmesine dayanır. Elçiler çoğu zaman kapsamlı çözümler yerine kademeli tavizlerin peşinden gider, çünkü erken bir atılım iç tepkilere yol açabilir. Bu tür müzakereler bu yüzden sık sık nihai bildirilerde kasıtlı bir belirsizlikle karakterize edilir.

Eleştirmenler, belirsizliğe duyulan bu eğilimin gerçek anlaşmazlıkları gizleyebileceğini ve taahhütlerin fark edilmeden zayıflamasına izin verebileceğini savunur. Savunucular ise muğlaklığın uzlaşma için alan bıraktığını yanıtlar, çünkü kesin biçimde ifade edilmiş bir anlaşmanın onaylanması imkânsız olabilir. Onlara göre bir anlaşmanın dayanıklılığı, netliğinden çok iki tarafın da ona uymaya devam etme isteğine bağlıdır.
